annotations.title: Honeypot and rug-pull check for an ERC-20 before swap or approve

description:
Honeypot and rug-pull check for an ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum before a swap, approval or signature, read straight from the contract: upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967, beacon, clone), owner powers in the bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist, fee or max-tx setters, trading switch, burn from any address), owner renounced or active and the owner's share of supply; known issuers labeled. Risk low, medium or high with reasons. Signals, not investment advice. 0.015 USDC base (new payers 0.015, >10 payments 0.0105; 1 pack call).
After: preflight before your agent pays or signs on the site that offers this token (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack or buy_pack_with_card instead of paying per call.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments base price (new-payer surcharge paused), 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.
